segments.text: Class: 3-A

A girl who loves doing fun things but often seems to be in a bad mood, unless she spots something that interests her. Kukuri often skips school and wanders around downtown in search for exciting things all day and night. While her grades are decent, she is on the verge having to repeat a grade due to her constant absences.
There are rumors going around that she makes money through compensated dating...
Translated from Getchu
小柄で幼く見られがちな３年生。
退屈な事が嫌いな享楽主義者。
ほとんど不登校状態であり、刺激を求めて昼夜問わず繁華街をうろついている。
常に不機嫌で気怠そうだが、面白そうな事を見つけると目の色が変わる。
成績はそこそこだが、出席日数が足りないので留年の危機。
パパ活で稼いでいると学園では噂されているが……？
現在フリーター。
大和の助手。
『なっさけない顔……♪　それでも本当に先生？』

The student council president who is also Kukuri's classmate. She is the daughter of Toogami Private Academy's vice principal. A very polite girl who is always kind to everyone, however, because of her strong sense of justice, she won't tolerate anyone breaking the rules, which has led to some students fearing her. She has excellent grades and is always at the top of her class.
She also loves cute things.
Translated from Getchu
遠上学園の生徒会長を務める３年生。
白鷺教頭の娘であり、見め麗しき完全無欠のお嬢様。
物腰は柔らかく優雅で、いつも周囲に優しい笑顔を振りまいている。
成績は優秀で、学年一位から落ちた事がない。
正義感が強く、校則に反する事は許さない。
その為、一部の生徒達からは恐れられている。
カワイイ物が大好き。
大学１年生。
大和の助手。
『おはようございます、先生。
今日のネクタイ、とても素敵でお似合いですわ』

Toogami Private Academy's school nurse. Although she is quite new, she quickly became popular (especially with the male students) thanks to her calm personality and buxom body.
In reality, she was sent to the academy to investigate the flaming incidents. When Masayoshi enters the scene, she becomes his right-hand woman, and uses her talents to help him out in any way.
Translated from Getchu
遠上学園の学校保健師。
今年の春から赴任してきたばかりの新任教諭だが、クールな外見と言動とその豊満な身体で、生徒たち（特に男子生徒）からの人気を集める。
その正体は大和同様、炎上事件の調査に派遣されたエージェントであり、大和の有能な右腕。
大和同様、「焔硝岩相談所」に所属するエージェントであり、大和の有能な右腕。
「火伏せの巫女」として大和をサポートする。
今回は媛城女学院にシスターとして潜入している。
媛城女学院の修道女が着用する、由緒ある修道服を纏って登場。
『正義様、こちらにご用意しております』

A mysterious girl who constantly appears in front of Masayoshi. She claims to be involved with a lot of the school's incidents, dubbing herself the "ruler of the flaming incidents"...
Translated from Getchu
大和の前に度々現れる、神出鬼没の少女。
遠上学園で多発する、炎上事件に関係しているようだが……？
元カグツチの巫女。
八洲の元を離れ、現在は学園生活満喫中。
大和の前に度々現れる、神出鬼没の少女。
遠上学園で多発する、炎上事件に関係しているようだが……？

The protagonist. He is a specialist known as a "fire extinguisher", whose job is to "extinguish" and handle the flaming incidents. He transfers into the academy as a teacher in order to offer "guidance" to those who cause flaming incidents. He has the special skill of being able to discern a woman's body shape even through her clothes, and after seeing it, it will be etched in his memory forever.
His favorite food is meat, while his least favorite food is cucumbers.
Translated from Getchu
本編の主人公。
『火消し』と呼ばれる、炎上事件の鎮静化と生徒の教育を請け負うエージェント。
教師として学園に潜入し、炎上事件を起こす生徒たちに正義の『指導』を行う。
好きな物は肉。嫌いな物は胡瓜。
服の上からでも女性の体形を見抜く特技を持つ。
また、一度見た女性の体形は絶対に忘れない。

Class: Year 1, Viola Class 3

One of the Six Maidens who is known as the "Cool-headed Lady." A cool and rational girl who is regarded as a genius within her peers due to her intellect. Despite her rational nature, she is interested in the occult and supernatural things and as of recently, has even become extremely curious about conspiracy theories. As a result, she has come to the conclusion that the world is ruled by a corrupt and dark organization. She is also interested in artificial earthquakes and weather warfare.
She is close friends with Chitose, or rather, Chitose is one of the only people who can converse with Komari on an equal footing.
Translated from Getchu
六花媛のひとりで「冷徹お嬢様」の異名を持つ。
美しい髪をなびかせる、常に冷静沈着なクールビューティ。
一年生にして、媛城女学院の女生徒を代表する『六花媛』に選ばれたという異例の才女。
自他共に認める才媛だが、オカルト関係の話題を好み、最近は陰謀論に傾倒している。
人工地震とか気象兵器とか大好き。
この世界の裏には暗黒政府が存在すると信じている。
春日井ちとせと仲が良い。
というよりも、駒莉と対等に会話できるのが彼女しかいない。
『この事件……陰謀の匂いがするわ……』

Class: Year 1?

A mysterious girl who always carries around a parasol and has a tendency to appear out of nowhere. She speaks in a distinctive and old-fashioned way. Kamiya is often seen strolling around the academy, but because nobody knows her true identity, she is treated as if she were some kind of a fairy or mythical being. Each time she appears in front of Yamato, he has to go along with her whims, before she eventually leaves.
She loves meat and especially loves eating yakiniku, yakitori, and roast pork. At the same time, she can't stand raw foods like sashimi.
Translated from Getchu
常に日傘を持ち歩く、神出鬼没の謎の少女。
古風な喋り方が特徴的。
稀に学院内で見かけられるが、誰も正体を知らないので謎の妖精のような扱いを受けている。
大和の前に現れては、好き勝手に振る舞い去っていく。
肉全般が好物で、焼肉、焼き鳥、焼豚大好き。
刺身などのナマモノ全般はダメな偏食家。
『お主が火伏せの大和正義か。わしはカミヤじゃ』

Class: Year 3, Rose Class

One of the Six Maidens who is known as the "Splendid Lady." As her title suggests, Seira is a smart and good-natured girl who always has a smile on her face. She gets along with everyone and is adored by both her classmates and underclassmen. While she is popular with her peers, in reality she has no friends, and her smile masks her ruthless true nature, which is always ready to discard those she deems "useless."
She has a huge sweet tooth and especially loves eating parfaits.
Translated from Getchu
六花媛のひとりで「爛漫お嬢様」
その異名が示すように、いつも笑顔でニコニコしてる、聡明で明るく朗らかなお嬢様。
六花媛の中でも社交的なタイプで、その人当たりの良さから同級生、下級生問わず人気がある。
だがその笑顔の裏には冷酷な一面を持ち、
「使えない」と判断した人間は簡単に切り捨てる。
慕われるタイプだが、友人はいない。
甘い物大好きで、いつも大きなパフェを食べている。
『あはっ、先生も一緒に食べる？』

One of the Six Maidens who is known as the "Performer Lady." She is the ace of the rhythmic gymnastics club and has a very slender body. She is very caring and as a result has many fans and is very popular with her underclassmen. Because of said caring nature, many see her as an older sister-like figure.

Her family, the Yasunaga family, is known for being a prestigious samurai and tea ceremony family that has been around since the Edo period. As such many expect Suzuha to be an old-fashioned and proper girl, but in reality she has always been the type of person who speaks without thinking. As a result, her family practically forced her to transfer to the academy in order to "correct" her behavior, or in other words, make her learn some manners. Among the Six Maidens, she is also the one with the worst grades.
Translated from Getchu
六花媛のひとりで「演舞お嬢様」
すらりとしたスタイルが自慢の、新体操部のエース。
易永家は江戸時代から続く、由緒正しい武家茶道の名家。
古風な和風お嬢様……のはずだが、幼少期より口より先に手が出るタイプだったので、性格矯正を目的に、半ば強制的に媛城女学院へ放り込まれた。
六花媛の中では、学業成績が一番アレ。
それでも面倒見の良さからか、学院内にはファンが多く下級生から慕われており人気が高い。姉御肌。
『練習の邪魔をするなら、叩き出しますよ』

One of the Six Maidens who is known as the "Divine Revelation Lady." Her family owns the Nirei Group, one of the biggest companies in Japan, which also drives the Japanese economy. Meika is a perfect lady who has the looks and brains, and on top of that, she believes that whatever she says are God's words. She hates ugly, foolish and weak things. Due to her beauty, she is envied by the other students.
She has one significant flaw however, which is her severe tone deafness. Because of that, Meika is afraid of singing in front of the others, despite her love for singing.
She is also the one who came up with all of the Six Maidens' titles.
Translated from Getchu
六花媛のひとりで、まとめ役でもある「天啓お嬢様」
日本経済を牽引する、国内有数の企業「仁礼グループ」の息女。
容姿端麗、頭脳明晰で、自分の言葉は神の言葉だと本気で信じている節がある完璧お嬢様。王権神授説バンザイ。
切れ長の瞳と美しい黒髪が自慢で、全女学生たちの羨望の的。
醜い者、愚かな者、弱い者が嫌い。
六花媛のメンバーの二つ名は全部冥華が考えた。
唯一の欠点は歌。
歌うのが好きだが致命的に音痴であり、人前で歌えない事が悩みの種。
『この学院の生徒全ての模範となる事が、
わたくしの使命ですわ』

Class: Year 2, Lily Class

One of the Six Maidens who is known as the "Sunny Lady." She is a beautiful exchange student from Manzilmania University's affiliated school, located in the United States. Everyone calls her by her nickname "Clemy". Like her title suggests, she has a sunny disposition, and though she's relaxed most of the time, she gets very excited when talking about the things she likes.
She is fluent in Japanese, which she learnt through watching anime and reading manga, and she can also speak both French and German fluently.
Before coming to Japan, she was looking forward to tasting Japanese food, only to be shocked how it was different from what she imagined.
Translated from Getchu
六花媛のひとりで「日輪お嬢様」
アメリカ・マンジルマニア大学付属校からやって来た蒼い瞳の美少女留学生。
皆からは「クレミー」という愛称で呼ばれる。
その二つ名の通り、いつも楽しそうに笑っている。
落ち着いた性格だが、好きな物の話になるとテンションが上がる。
日本語が達者で、日本の漫画とアニメで覚えた。
ドイツ語、フランス語も自由に話せるマルチリンガル。
来日前は日本食に興味があったが、思っていたのと違って少しショックを受けている。
『ハジメまして。クレミーと呼んでくださイ！』

Class: Year 1, Viola Class 3

Chitose is a cheerful and curious girl who tends to stick her nose into everything. Due to her personality, she is popular and has lots of friends. Her uncle is the president of one of Japan's leading toy manufacturers, and her family runs a subsidiary of said company.
Chitose has been close friends with Komari ever since she helped Chitose out after enrolling at Himeshiro Girls' Academy.
Translated from Getchu
好奇心旺盛で、何にでも首を突っ込みたがる性格の少女。
朗らかで明るく素直な性格で友人も多く、クラスメイトたちからの評判も良い。
媛城に入学直後、駒莉に助けてもらった事が縁となり以降、駒莉と仲良くしている。
叔父が国内有数の玩具メーカーの社長で、実家はその下請けの子会社。
弟がひとりいる。
『また駒莉ちゃんってば……』

Class: Year 2, Lily Class

One of the Six Maidens who is known as the "Wisdom Lady." She is a genius who was born into the Ashitani family, which is known for producing many renowed scholars. Karin is an extremely proud girl who doesn't know how to speak formally and as such talks to both her peers and teachers in the same way. She hates men more than anything and is extremely prejudiced towards the opposite sex.

She rarely leaves her room and often spends time on the internet, surfing through social media and anonymous messaging boards. However, because of her short temper, she tends to get easily get trolled.
The two things she's not confident about are her height and boob size.
Translated from Getchu
六花媛のひとりで「叡智お嬢様」
著名な学者を輩出する名家、阿詩谷家に生まれた天才少女。
自分の知性に絶対的な自信を持っている。
敬語は苦手で、教師や目上でも変わらない口調で話す。
普段、あまり自室から出てくる事なく、常にネットに入り浸っている。
匿名掲示板やＳＮＳが大好きだが、キレやすい性格で沸点が低いため、ネットでの煽りに弱い。
また極度の男嫌いで、異性に対する偏見が強い。
身長と胸がコンプレックス。
『私に何か用か？　時間の無駄だ、手短にな』

A mathematics teacher at Himeshiro Girls' Academy and an alumnus of the academy who always wears revealing clothes. Before graduating, she was also a member of the Six Maidens. In contrast to her showy appearance, Natsumi is a kind and friendly woman who is particularly popular with the male teachers.
She is also a heavy drinker as well as a ruthless sadist who loves making both men and women submit to her.
Translated from Getchu
いつも露出度の高い服を着ている
数学科担当の美人女教師。２８歳。
元媛城女学院の卒業生で、元六花媛でもある。
その派手な恰好とは裏腹に、誰にでも優しく親切で男性教諭たちから人気がある。
重度の酒好き。
実は極度のサドであり、男も女も調教して屈服させるのが大好き。
『あら先生。ふふっ、今夜はお暇ですか？』
